component.name: Gordeck
component.summary: Free and Open Source Client for PlayStation Remote Play for the Steam Deck, based on chiaki4deck
Cliente livre e de código aberto de Remote Play para PlayStation no Steam Deck, baseado no chiaki4deck

description.p: Chiaki is a Free and Open Source Client for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 Remote Play. It can be used to play in real time on a PlayStation as long as there is a network connection.
